title: Canonical - Vesting Start Transaction
description: Canonical (hypothetical OCF) representation of a vesting-start transaction. Supplies the per-grant date anchor used by any DATE-anchored `VestingStatement` in the security's template (see `VestingBaseDate`). EVENT-anchored statements are anchored separately via TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT. The template reference itself lives on the issuance transaction; this transaction supplies only the per-security date anchor. One per security.

date.description: The date anchor for DATE-anchored statements on the referenced security's template. EVENT-anchored statements ignore this; their firing dates come from TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT.

security_id.description: Identifier of the security whose DATE-anchored statements anchor at `date`. The security's `vesting_template_id` is read from the issuance transaction; this transaction does not re-carry it.
